full_judgment: 4. The case of the plaintiff, in short, is that the suit land appertaining to C.S. khatian  No. 297/3 corresponding to S.A. khatians No. 283 of mouza Thumnia within the Police Station Baliadangi, District-Thakurgaon originally belonged to Ashi Md. Sheikh and Jutu Mohammad, the two brothers. They partitioned their joint property with their other sharers, vide registered partition deed No. 3003 dated 07.08.1956. According to the partition deed, Ashi Md. Sheikh alias Asiruddin got 10 decimals of land of plot No. 8066 and 22 decimals of land of plot No. 8067, in total, 32 decimals of land and he sold the said 32 decimals of land to Md. Jahedul Hoq and Md. Mazedul Hoq by two registered deeds. After that, Md. Mazedul Hoq transferred 44½ decimals of land to the plaintiff, vide registered sale deed No. 5433 dated 02.07.2000. It is mentionable that he transferred 2½, decimals out of 10 decimals of land of suit plot No.8066. Jahanul Hoq  transferred 5 decimals of land of the suit plot No.8066. Thus the plaintiff had been enjoying and possessing 7½, decimals of land out of 10 decimals of land of the suit plot No.8066 within the knowledge of all including the defendants. The plaintiff filled up the land with earth but on 12.05.2004, the defendants illegally took possession of the suit land by erecting house made of corrugated iron and bamboo fences in the absence of the plaintiff. On 22.05.2004, the plaintiff requested the defendants to hand over possession but the defendants threatened the plaintiff and refused to hand over possession. Consequently, the plaintiff lodged General Diary No.784, dated 22.05.2004.
